description.value: Baik Mi is a Korean restaurant in Gibsons on British Columbia's Sunshine Coast, serving traditional Korean cuisine with both dine-in and online ordering options. Located at 900 Sunnycrest Road, it is a local independent spot catering to the Gibsons community and visitors alike. Touring cyclists rolling off the ferry or exploring the Sunshine Coast Highway will find it a convenient stop for a hot Korean meal.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business name, address (900 Sunnycrest Rd, Gibsons, BC), and phone number, all matching OSM. The site's 'Order Online' header and 'Please use our online ordering system' message confirms takeout/online ordering is available. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cycle-specific amenities. A discrepancy exists between OSM opening hours and the website: OSM omits Wednesday hours (implying closed) but the website lists Wednesday as open; OSM shows Tuesday closing at 19:30 but website shows 20:30; OSM omits Thursday but website shows Thursday as closed.
concerns: OSM opening hours conflict with website: OSM omits Wednesday (implying closed) but website lists Wednesday as open; OSM shows Tuesday closing at 19:30 but website shows 20:30 for Tuesday; OSM does not list Thursday but website explicitly marks Thursday as closed. OSM hours should be updated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open Korean restaurant in Gibsons with a functioning website and confirmed contact details. A useful dining stop for touring cyclists on the Sunshine Coast.

wow_evidence: local independent spot catering to the Gibsons community
